title: Transfer window planning
summary: Compare and review circular or elliptical orbit changes.

blocks.text: While coasting in a bound orbit, choose Transfers in the flight toolbar, or open Maneuver and choose the Transfer window tab. No existing node is needed. Destinations are grouped by the current body, its moons, the parent SOI, other planets and their moons. Body names identify which orbit they belong to, and unavailable transfer types are marked. Choose a body and enter a target altitude in metres above its reference radius. Turn off Circular target to enter separate low/high altitudes. Starting and target orbits may be elliptical; both must clear the highest terrain. Supports orbit raising/lowering, direct parent/child transfers and siblings around a common parent, including moons and planets. Deeper destinations need separate legs. Find transfer windows searches bounded sampled windows and validates real moving-body SOI handoffs and contact. Compare compact efficient/faster cards for wait, travel and delta-v; expand Burn estimates & limits for durations, then adopt an inert editable departure/arrival plan. Arrows show each burn direction, with delta-v and duration at the current throttle setting; zero throttle shows no thrust. Automatic execution still uses full throttle. These are impulsive estimates: review actual flight after each burn and SOI change, then choose Execute separately or fly manually. Saved/loaded plans never arm.

Find transfer windows compares Efficient (lowest impulse cost among the sampled opportunities) and Faster (earlier arrival when available). Compare current wait, travel time, total delta-v and each burn duration. The search is bounded; these labels do not promise a global optimum. Changes to thrust, orbit, destination or altitude discard old results.

Use an option to create editable Departure and Arrival nodes. Generation never arms thrust. Select a node to edit it; Execute burn is a separate choice for each node, or fly manually. The dashed preview assumes instantaneous impulses. Long burns can change arrival substantially. After a finite or manually flown departure, mark manual nodes flown if needed and Review remaining against actual flight before attempting arrival. Export plan stores inert intent; Save universe includes it. Loaded plans always need review.
